name: web-range-calendar-with-black-endpoints-and-grey-selected-band
title: August 2026 date-range picker with black rounded endpoint tiles on the 12th and 16th, a pale band between them and faded neighbours
whatItIs: A white card with month navigation arrows and 'August 2026', weekday letters and a grid of dates where 12 (with a dot) and 16 are black tiles with rounded outer edges, the dates between are on a pale grey band and out-of-month days are light grey, with a hand cursor near 25.
whatItMeans: Clear and simple; black endpoints and a soft band show the range at a glance.
techniques: Show endpoints as black rounded tiles.
Fill the range with a pale band.

vocabulary.definition: A start and end date with a highlighted span.
The filled tile at each end of a range.
A faded date from another month.
